**Introduction to Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.**

Located at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, **Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.** is a leading innovator in the field of chemical materials, dedicated to research, development, production, and distribution of high-performance chemical products. As a key player in China’s chemical industry, the company leverages advanced technology and sustainable practices to deliver cutting-edge solutions for various industrial sectors, including coatings, adhesives, textiles, plastics, and construction materials.

With a strong commitment to quality and innovation, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of **functional resins, additives, specialty chemicals, and new polymer materials**, catering to both domestic and international markets. The company’s state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities adhere to strict quality control standards, ensuring that all products meet or exceed industry regulations and customer expectations. Backed by a team of experienced chemists, engineers, and industry experts, the company continuously invests in **R&D** to develop eco-friendly, high-efficiency materials that address the evolving demands of modern industries.

Strategically situated in **Hangzhou**, a hub of economic and technological advancement in Zhejiang, the company benefits from excellent logistics, a robust supply chain, and proximity to major ports and industrial clusters. This strategic location enhances its ability to serve clients across China and globally while fostering collaborations with research institutions and industry partners.

Driven by a vision of **sustainability, innovation, and customer satisfaction**, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is poised to make significant contributions to the chemical materials sector, supporting industries in their pursuit of efficiency, durability, and environmental responsibility.
